rationale: Builds directly on the current 9x512 recurrent-tail best without adding new modules, extra parameters, or extra forward passes. The change late-aligns the existing encoder-decoder skip injections so both recurrent tail blocks receive direct skip context, which targets an underexplored traversal/output-path idea that fits the 600-second Mac-mini budget and compounds with the proven tail QK float-rescue endgame.
title: Late-Aligned Decoder Skips For Recurrent Tail
